_comment: Packaging-side licence manifest (P17 / ADR-0004, #653), the complement to license-exceptions.json. gate:licenses scans the npm/py DEPENDENCY tree; it is blind to what our IMAGES ship. This file declares the two surfaces it cannot see, and gate:image-licenses (scripts/gates.mjs) audits them: `images` = third-party container images pinned by deploy-owned compose, Helm, Lite Dockerfile FROM surfaces, or Lite Makefile `*_IMAGE` variables (an undeclared pin fails; a non-permissive one needs a logged `reason`); `bundled` = components baked INTO a published ghcr.io/andai/* image (redistribution — Cat A or Cat-B-with-reason only, Cat X always fails). `name` matches an image ref with its :tag stripped. The per-release SPDX SBOM inventories every package name installed by the Lite final stage; because Docker source cannot resolve Ubuntu package versions or licences, those fields stay NOASSERTION until an image-level scanner enriches them.

images.name: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright
images.note: Pinned base and builder image for Munshi Lite. Playwright is Apache-2.0; Ubuntu package names installed in the final stage are separately inventoried in the SPDX with unresolved fields stated as NOASSERTION.

images.name: valkey/valkey
images.note: compose + helm cache/stream store (#653). BSD-3 permissive; parity with the Lite source-build.

images.name: postgres
images.note: Primary datastore. The PostgreSQL Licence is an OSI-approved permissive (BSD/MIT-style) licence.

images.name: edoburu/pgbouncer
images.note: Connection pooler. Wrapper image is MIT; PgBouncer itself is ISC — both Category A.

images.name: versity/versitygw
images.note: Object storage for Lite and Compose (the `storage` sidecar): versitygw with its POSIX backend, recordings as plain files in a local volume. Apache-2.0 is Category A. Pinned by tag and digest in deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml and deploy/lite/Makefile (the gate scans the Lite Makefile image variables).

images.name: fedirz/faster-whisper-server
images.note: Opt-in local CPU speech-to-text sidecar for Lite (LOCAL_STT, WHISPER_IMAGE in deploy/lite/Makefile). Upstream speaches-ai/speaches (formerly fedirz/faster-whisper-server), MIT, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact.

images.name: axllent/mailpit
images.note: Development and CI mail catcher in the andai compose overlay (andai/deploy/compose/docker-compose.andai.yml, andai/images.json third_party), andai-core's default SMTP relay (D-30). MIT, Category A. Pulled as-is and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact.

images.name: prom/prometheus
images.note: Metrics and alert-rule evaluation in the andai compose overlay's opt-in `monitoring` profile (OPS-05, D-62). Pinned to the 3.13 LTS line by tag and digest (andai/images.json third_party). Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact. The andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring runs the same tag and digest (subchart prometheus-community/prometheus 29.45.1).

images.name: prom/alertmanager
images.note: Alert routing (email, Slack, Teams Workflows receivers, all off by default) in the andai compose overlay's opt-in `monitoring` profile (OPS-05, D-62). Pinned by tag and digest. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact. The andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring runs the same tag and digest (subchart alertmanager in prometheus-community/prometheus 29.45.1).

images.name: prom/node-exporter
images.note: Filesystem metrics for the storage alert in the andai compose overlay's opt-in `monitoring` and `monitoring-test` profiles (OPS-05). Pinned by tag and digest. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact. The andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring runs the same tag and digest as a DaemonSet (subchart prometheus-node-exporter in prometheus-community/prometheus 29.45.1).

images.name: persesdev/perses
images.note: Operator dashboards as code in the andai compose overlay's opt-in `monitoring` profile (OPS-05, D-62: an Apache-2.0 viewer instead of AGPL Grafana). Pinned by tag and digest; pre-1.0, so dashboards are linted against the pinned version. No telemetry setting exists in v0.55.1. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact. The andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring runs the same tag and digest (subchart perses/perses 0.24.0).

images.name: chrislusf/seaweedfs
images.note: Object storage for the andai Helm chart (deploy/helm/charts/andai, subchart seaweedfs 4.53.0): master, volume and filer with the S3 gateway, SSE-S3 keyed from an operator Secret. SeaweedFS reports usage to its vendor by default; the chart runs every master with -telemetry=false and refuses a render without it. Pinned by tag (4.53); the digest is pinned before the first pull. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact.

images.name: quay.io/prometheus-operator/prometheus-config-reloader
images.note: Reloads Prometheus and Alertmanager when their mounted config or rules change, in the andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring (subchart prometheus-community/prometheus 29.45.1). Pinned by tag (v0.95.1); the digest is pinned before the first pull. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact.

images.name: registry.k8s.io/kube-state-metrics/kube-state-metrics
images.note: Pod phase and node capacity series (Pending bot Pods) for the andai Helm chart's opt-in monitoring (subchart prometheus-community/prometheus 29.45.1, collectors pods and nodes only). Pinned by tag (v2.20.0); the digest is pinned before the first pull. Apache-2.0, Category A. User-pulled and not redistributed inside any ghcr.io/andai/* artifact.

images.name: nvcr.io/nvidia/k8s/dcgm-exporter
images.note: GPU metrics for the GPU dashboard in the andai Helm chart (gpuMetrics.enabled, off by default). The exporter's source is Apache-2.0, but the container image bundles NVIDIA DCGM under NVIDIA's own terms, which are not yet checked: the chart names no image and refuses to render dcgm-exporter until the operator sets gpuMetrics.image to one they have cleared. Not pulled, not shipped, not redistributed.

bundled.name: valkey
bundled.how: source-build from the pinned git tag 8.1.9 (deploy/lite/Dockerfile.lite valkey-builder stage); valkey-server + valkey-cli copied into the final image, COPYING preserved at /usr/local/share/valkey/LICENSE
bundled.reason: XAUTOCLAIM parity with compose/helm and off BOTH jammy apt's stale Redis 6.0.16 (no XAUTOCLAIM) and source-available Redis ≥7.4 (RSALv2/SSPLv1). BSD-3 is Category A — clean to redistribute (#653).
